plans.for: Turn happy visits into Google reviews
items: Review request after every visit, stay or class
Print-ready QR code for the counter and receipts

Come-back reminders when a customer is due
You approve every message before it goes out

sprint.name: Win-Back Sprint
sprint.text: Not ready for a monthly plan? One 30-day campaign to your list of past customers: we write it, send it and hand you every reply.

terms: No contract. Cancel any time. Setup is included.
channels: Messages go out by e-mail, from your own name. Text messages (SMS) and WhatsApp can be added where your customers have agreed to them; carrier fees are passed on at cost.
